Total number of questions — 15
Strengthening of defence-industrial
base
*91. SHRIMATI SAROJINI
HEMBRAM: Will the Minister of
DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) what are the various measures taken
by Government to strengthen the defence-
industrial base, in order to boost
Government’s ‘Make-in-India’ Policy;
(b) whether Government is coming out
with more such measures in the near future;
(c) if so, the details thereof; and
(d) if not, the reasons therefor?
Allocation for new weapon system
and modernisation in Army
*92. SHRI K. RAHMAN KHAN: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the provision made for new weapon
system and modernisation in the budget
2018-19;
(b) whether this allocation also includes
the payments of instalments of earlier arms
deals; and
(c) if so, the actual amount left over for
purchase of new weapon system and
modernisation for the forces in the Indian
Army?
Assistance to handloom weavers
*93. SHRI K. BHABANANDA
SINGH: Will the Minister of TEXTILES
be pleased to state:
(a) whether Government assists the
handloom weavers across the country, if
so, the details thereof;
(b) whether a large concentration of
women handloom weavers exist in Manipur,
if so, the details thereof; and
(c) the details of assistance provided to
them and scheme applicable for improving
their socio-economic conditions?

33
Status of National Highway projects
in the country
*94. DR. T. SUBBARAMI REDDY:
Will the Minister of ROAD TRANSPORT
AND HIGHWAYS be pleased to state:
(a) the details of ongoing/pending projects
of construction and development of National
Highways projects in the country, State-wise,
especially in Andhra Pradesh and Telangana,
during the last three years;
(b) the details of funds allocated by the
Government and spent for this purpose,
year-wise; and
(c) the timeline by which these projects
will be completed and the details thereof?
Status of open defecation in the
country
†*95. SHRI VISHAMBHAR
PRASAD NISHAD: Will the Minister of
DRINKING WATER AND
SANITA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the number of persons defecating in
open at the time of initiation of Swachh
Bharat Mission in October, 2014 and the
number of people still defecating in open
as on January, 2018;
(b) the number of districts and villages
that have been declared open defecation
free till now;
(c) details of factual position of villages
and districts which have been declared open
defecation free; and
(d) the stand of the Ministry with
regard to incidents of assaults on people
found defecating in open, during Open
Defecation Free campaign?
Unutilised funds for ‘Namami Gange’
programme
*96. SHRI VIVEK K. TANKHA: Will
the Minister of WA TER RESOURCES,
RIVER DEVELOPMENT AND GANGA
REJUVENA TION be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that CAG in its
39th Report has stated that ` 2,600 crore,
sanctioned between 2014-2017, for
‘Namami Gange’ programme is lying
unutilised in the banks; and
(b) if so, the amount sanctioned for this
project and details of the reason for non-
utilisation of funds?
Dam rehabilitation and improvement
programme
*97. SHRI VIVEK GUPTA: Will the
Minister of W ATER RESOURCES,
RIVER DEVELOPMENT AND GANGA
REJUVENA TION be pleased to state:
(a) the reasons for more than 40 per
cent shortfall in utilisation of funds allocated
to dam rehabilitation and improvement
programme in 2017-18;
(b) State-wise release of funds under
this programme;
(c) the reasons for reduction in grants
given to the State Governments for flood,
river and water management, by more than
59 per cent in 2018-19 as compared to
` 1,586 crore in 2016-17; and
(d) State-wise details of the grants
released for flood, river and water
management during the last three years?
Status of NW-4
*98. SHRI C.M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of SHIPPING be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that the work on
National Waterways-4 (NW-4) has started
in Andhra Pradesh;
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

(b) details of the timeline by which first
phase is likely to be completed and by when
the entire NW-4 is going to be completed; and
(c) to what extent, NW-4 would help in
movement of goods and passengers?

cleaning up the highly toxic areas under
Swachh Bharat Mission, in and around the

Total number of questions — 160
Manufacture of light weight bullet-
proof jackets
†961. SHRI LAL SINH VADODIA:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government
is considering to make light weight bullet-
proof jackets;
(b) if so, whether Government has taken
any steps in this regard; and
(c) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Uniforms for Army personnel
962. SHRI AMAR SINGH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that Government,
has started paying a fixed amount of money
to Army personnel to buy their uniforms
contrary to the previous arrangement,
wherein they were provided with uniforms
and if so, the details thereof;
(b) whether it is also a fact that Army
personnel have refused to accept cash
allowance and demanded uniforms as per
earlier practice; and
(c) if so, what is Government's reaction
in regard thereto?
Supply of fake Chinese parts for
Dhanush Guns
963. SHRI C. M. RAMESH: Will the
Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) whether it has come to the notice of
the Ministry that fake Chinese parts for
Dhanush Guns, camouflaged as 'Made in
Germany' are being supplied; and
(b) if so, the details thereof and the
action taken by Government in this regard?
Violations of LoC
964. SHRI A. VIJAY AKUMAR: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) the details of countrywide breach of
225
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

226
Line of Control (LoC) in the country during
the last three years;
(b) whether it is a fact that the Indo-
Chinese border cannot be approached by
the Indian Army; and
(c) if so, the details of such areas and
reasons therefor?
Military power ranking of India
†965. SHRI NARESH AGRAW AL:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) whether it is a fact that India stands
at 10th rank as regards military power, as
compared to other countries;
(b) if so the reasons therefor; and
(c) if not, the status of military power
of India in comparison to the  developed
and neighbouring countries?
Chinese military activity in Pakistan
966. SHRI K. C. RAMAMURTHY:
Will the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased
to state:
(a) the opinion of the Ministry on the
report of Pentagon, that China is setting
up a military base in Pakistan;
(b) whether the Ministry is also aware
of the fact that China has sent nuclear
submarines to Karachi in May last year;
(c) whether it is a fact that 'One Road
One Belt' (OROB) and 'String of Pearls'
are also part of China's grand objective to
encircle lndia strategically; and
(d) if so, what counter plans does the
Ministry have to protect the country?
Terror attacks on Army camps
†967. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state :
(a) whether it is a fact that terrorists
entered and attacked family quarters of
Sunjuwan army camp on 10th February,
2018;
(b) whether it is also a fact that terrorists
again attacked security forces camp in
Karan Nagar area of Srinagar, on 12th
February, 2018;
(c) whether a number of incidents of
terrorist attacks on security forces camps
have taken place during last three years;
(d) whether concrete steps have been
taken by the Government to prevent
terrorist attacks; and
(e) if so, the details thereof and if not,
the reasons therefor?
Chinese military deployment in
Doklam
†968. SHRI MOTILAL VORA: Will
the Minister of DEFENCE be pleased to
state:
(a) whether it is a fact that satellite
images have revealed that China has
constructed seven helipads in Doklam and
tanks and missiles have been stationed
there;
(b) whether China can use them against
India;
(c) if so, Government's reaction thereto;
and
(d) whether Government has held talks
with the Chinese Government regarding
this and the outcome thereof?
†Original notice of the question received in Hindi.

227
Recruitment of pilots in armed forces
969. SHRI HARSHVARDHAN
SINGH DUNGARPUR: Will the Minister
of DEFENCE be pleased to state:
(a) the procedure of filling up the post
of pilots in Armed Forces;
(b) the total number of sanctioned posts
of pilots in the Armed Forces of the country
along with the number of pilots actually
working and the number of posts lying
vacant, as on date;
(c) whether the Defence Forces are
facing shortage of pilots;
(d) if so, whether any review has ever
been made in regard to the reasons for this
shortage of pilots;
(e) if so, the details thereof; and
(f) the details of measures being
adopted by Government in this regard?
